findings.title: Committing one map input event loses focus and relocates the caret
findings.given: Real mounted Database and real fixture-bound authoring controller; canonical object selected through mounted card. Map text input focused, value stamp-target and caret 5 verified before inserting X with setRangeText.
findings.when: Dispatch one bubbling InputEvent with inputType insertText and data X, without refocusing after the event.
findings.mechanism: commitMap calls onChange for every input event. spatialShell refresh forwards to real Database rerender; renderActiveTab(forceFresh) removes the body children and recreates fields. No focus/selection restoration occurs in that chain. The test asserts the currently mounted input, so replacement would be allowed if focus and caret were restored.
findings.recommendation: Keep the editing field's focus and selection continuous across input-state updates, either by avoiding whole-panel replacement for these events or restoring the active field and selection deliberately. Preserve the validated project-key reset, empty-seed state and pre-pin numeric rejection.
findings.limit: Reproduced under happy-dom with a real InputEvent and full app render/controller chain. Not a physical keyboard/browser claim; Grok owns physical multi-character typing. Seed and numeric fields share an input-rerender pattern by source inspection but were not separately probed.
